data.long_meaning: The name Jed comes from the Hebrew language and means 'friend' or 'companion'. It is a name rooted in the biblical tradition, specifically referenced in the Old Testament book of Genesis as the name of the father of Job. The name Jed carries the meaning “Friend, companion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jed usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This name carries a deep tradition, connecting us to the strong stories and narratives of the Jewish and Christian faiths.
